notes: From docs/packages/Package4.pdf (printed spec, no selectable text; Big Bass Bonanza 1000 reference). 5x3, 10 paylines, max win 2,100x, bet 0.20-150.00, RTP 96.81, high volatility. 3+ scatters trigger Free Spins (spec lists 3/4/5 scatters = 20/15/20 spins as printed). Two scatters can fire a Scatter Respin that hooks a third scatter into Bonus Mode. Buy Bonus purchases 10 free spins; Enhance Bet raises the feature chance. Fish symbols are Money symbols carrying a bet-multiple value (table: 2x, 5x, 10x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 2000x; the Instances section also mentions 15x). During Free Spins each Wild (Symbol 18, Collector) collects every Money value on screen; every 4th Wild collected retriggers +10 spins and raises the Money multiplier to 2x, then 3x, then 10x (three retriggers max). freeSpinRetrigger=true covers that Wild-collect retrigger; scatter retriggers are only 'optional based on design' in the spec. tumble=false: payline wins, and staging /bet has no slot.tumbles. Staging /bet on all three titles (PROBE-001 bet-shape.json, 2026-10-21): slot.area is column-major 5x3 (5 arrays of 3), slot.money is a parallel 5x3 grid of Money values (0 = none), slot.paylines, slot.freeSpin.items, slot.base.win / slot.bonus.win. The live base-game area only showed ids 0-10, so fish values arrive in slot.money rather than as ids 11-17. rowOrder is left at the default until an overlay confirms it on screen.
